facts.statement: Leivanectes is a genus of plesiosaurs belonging to the family Elasmosauridae.
facts.quote: Leivanectes is a genus of plesiosaurs of the family Elasmosauridae

facts.statement: The only known species, L. bernadoi, was described in 2019.
facts.quote: It contains a single species, L. bernadoi, which was described in 2019.

facts.statement: Fossils of Leivanectes come from Late Aptian marine deposits in central Colombia.
facts.quote: known from Late Aptian marine deposits in central Colombia

facts.statement: Remains were found in the Paja Formation near Villa de Leyva in the Boyaca department of Colombia.
facts.quote: Leivanectes remains have been found in the fossiliferous Paja Formation of the Altiplano Cundiboyacense, which crops out near Villa de Leyva, also written as Villa de Leiva, Boyaca, Colombia.

facts.statement: The genus name honors the location Villa de Leiva.
facts.quote: The genus name refers to Villa de Leiva.

facts.statement: Leivanectes is classified within the order Plesiosauria and the family Elasmosauridae.
facts.quote: regnum: Animalia phylum: Chordata classis: Sauropsida superordo: Sauropterygia ordo: Plesiosauria subordo: Plesiosauroidea familia: Elasmosauridae

facts.statement: Fossils originate from Aptian-era marine deposits in central Colombia.
facts.quote: cuyos fósiles provienen de depósitos marinos de la época del Aptiense del centro de Colombia

facts.statement: Leivanectes lived between 119.57 and 113.2 million years ago during the Aptian stage.
facts.quote: Time range: Aptian to Aptian (119.57 to 113.2 million years ago)

rejected.statement: Leivanectes has a short lower jaw symphysis with three tooth sockets, whereas Callawayasaurus has five.
rejected.quote: Leivanectes differs from Callawayasaurus... in having fewer mandibular alveoli and a short mandibular symphysis with three alveoli (five in Callawayasaurus)
